notes: Bumped after the v0.107.0..v0.108.0 sweep. Most docs were already updated inside the release itself (33 files, incl. the new features/bring-your-own-llm-key.mdx), so this sweep covered only the gaps. NEW features/ai-agents.mdx (#3838/#3840/#3877/#3893/#3931/#3953/#3976): agent kinds, runs ledger and its 8 statuses, propose-and-approve via the Approvals inbox, agent-attributed audit, ai_agents:read/write, MFA on mutations, and the managed alert-triage automation. Documented Off/Shadow as the ONLY accepted modes (SUPPORTED_AGENT_MODES=['off','shadow']) — 'act' is defined but rejected, so agents cannot execute autonomously in this release. deploy/environment.mdx: BREEZE_AI_AGENTS_ENABLED row (default false, compose environment: mapping caveat). reference/users-and-roles.mdx: ai_agents resource + why it is separate from organizations:write. features/automations.mdx: ai_triage action row marked system-managed + caution that the API rejects user-authored ai_triage (ai_triage_is_system_managed) and filtering lives on the agent policy. features/notifications.mdx: lastTestedAt/lastTestStatus/lastTestError persistence and the redaction note. features/alerts.mdx: rule Test reports the real verdict for the rule as open in the editor, incl. unsaved edits. docsMapping.ts: /settings/ai-agents and /approvals (both routes existed, neither was mapped) + 2 tests. Verified already correct, NO action: features/scripts.mdx — tenantSecret parameters are already fully documented under 'Parameter sources' and 'Secret variables in scripts' using UI labels rather than the internal identifier (an internal-name grep falsely reads as a gap here). Deliberately skipped as not admin-visible: the ~40 internal fixes (SQLSTATE unwrapping, lock ordering, the 40P01 deadlock fix, epoch-aligned job staggering, Sentry groupability, i18n entity rendering), the migration-ordering CI guard (#4063), and the multi-currency / quotes / portal work already covered by the in-release doc updates.
